key_highlights: ASX slides as oil surpasses $US100 on Iran conflict, fuelling RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks fall
Iron ore weakness spreads across BHP, RIO, FMG as China demand softens amid US-China tensions
RBA perceived to 'choose recession' — business conditions weakest since pandemic, home buyer sentiment collapses
WA gold sector active: Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway all advancing projects
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Austal jumps on $1.9b bid; Flagship ups copper stakes as red metal soars
High-end property sees steepest falls while affordable end remains resilient; NZ house crash returns
Data centre energy demand strains NSW grid; power giant seeks AI data centres at coal plants

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural downtrend ('drowning, not waving'); copper and gold counter-cyclical strength. WA gold juniors active with multiple drill-out announcements.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure from weak iron ore and China demand. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) and copper (STO.AX, FMG.AX) offer relative strength. WA juniors (AUR.AX, GDR.AX, FRT.AX, GWP.AX) attract speculative flows.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears and credit stress. Bathla private credit collapse raises contagion concerns. Qantas $35m payout signals corporate stress.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX pressured by higher-for-longer rates compressing equity valuations while credit losses rise. Private credit exposure a key risk vector.

sectors.trend: Oil above $100 on Iran conflict; data centre demand strains NSW grid. Power giant pivoting coal sites to AI data centres.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from energy scarcity premium. Coal-to-data-centre transition creates new revenue streams but delays energy transition. Inflationary pass-through pressures consumers.

sectors.trend: High-end property sees steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. Home buyer sentiment at new lows. NZ house crash returns as warning.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face rental pressure in premium segments. Construction (WBC.AX, WES.AX) may see delayed project pipelines. Housing affordability divergence limits broad-based recovery.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Austal $1.9b bid signals M&A activity. Qantas redundancy payouts signal sector stress.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX under pressure from cost base. Industrial M&A (AUS.AX) offers consolidation opportunities. Consumer discretionary (WOW.AX, WES.AX) faces squeezed household budgets.

key_themes: Oil shock ($100+) driving inflation re-acceleration and RBA tightening cycle
Iron ore structural weakness vs gold/copper counter-cyclical strength
Private credit contagion risk post-Bathla collapse
Housing bifurcation: luxury crash vs affordable resilience
Energy transition disrupted by AI data centre demand
China-US geopolitical tension impacting commodity demand
Business confidence at pandemic lows signalling potential recession

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, WLE.AX; reduce consumer discretionary; increase gold allocation
Reduce rate-sensitive REITs and property exposure; favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, WOL.AX)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate from BHP.AX/RIO.AX iron ore exposure to gold and copper names; monitor China stimulus
Review bank credit exposure; avoid illiquid credit instruments; monitor CBA.AX, NAB.AX loan book quality

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market bifurcation / buyer sentiment collapse
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid luxury REITs; favour affordable-segment exposure; monitor RBA housing data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW energy shortfall / data centre strain
risk_assessment.mitigation: Long energy generators; monitor AEMO capacity warnings; consider SXG.AX, WLE.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper miners as inflation hedge and counter-cyclical play
opportunities.rationale: WA gold pipeline active (Auric, Golden Dragon, Gateway); copper soars on supply constraints; oil-driven inflation supports metals

opportunities.recommendation: Long energy generators on structural demand from data centres and oil premium
opportunities.rationale: NSW grid strain, coal-to-data-centre pivot, $100 oil supports WDS/WLE/SXG earnings

opportunities.recommendation: Selective M&A play on Austal $1.9b bid
opportunities.rationale: Defence/shipbuilding consolidation; strategic value in industrial M&A

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore exposure; rotate to gold/copper within materials
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' with China demand weakness; structural oversupply risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim rate-sensitive REITs and luxury property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening + buyer sentiment collapse + high-end price falls; NZ crash as warning

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash / short-duration bonds; reduce equity beta
defensive_moves.rationale: Business conditions at pandemic lows; recession risk elevated; 'war on equities' narrative

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil >$100, RBA rate-hike fears, iron ore weakness, and private credit stress create headwinds. Expect ^AXJO to test support. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative outperformance. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. If RBA forces recession, earnings revisions downward across sectors. Iron ore structural weakness persists. Gold/copper and energy remain structural beneficiaries. Housing bifurcation limits broad recovery. China stimulus timing is critical swing factor.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (recession vs inflation trade-off)
Iron ore price trajectory and China stimulus signals
Iran conflict resolution / oil price normalisation
Bathla fallout and private credit market stress testing
watch_list: RBA cash rate and forward guidance
NSW AEMO frequency and capacity alerts
